e33chat.screen.title: Chat
e33chat.description: Rebuilds the vanilla chat HUD in chat-app style
e33chat.config.title: E33Chat Settings
e33chat.config.discard.title: Discard Changes
e33chat.config.theme.desc: Switch the chat panel color theme (Dark / Light)
e33chat.config.enabled.desc: Turn the custom chat overlay on or off
e33chat.config.red_dot.desc: Show a red dot on the chat icon for unread messages
e33chat.config.hide_chat_icon.desc: Hide the on-screen chat icon (and its red dot)
e33chat.config.animation.desc: Play an animation when opening or closing the chat screen
e33chat.config.panel_anim_style.desc: Animation style for opening/closing the chat panel and sidebar
e33chat.config.banner_anim_style.desc: Animation style for notification banners appearing and leaving
e33chat.config.banner_max_stack.desc: Maximum number of banners shown at once when new banners arrive (1-5, default 3)
e33chat.config.popup_anim_style.desc: Animation style for the settings/emoji/quick-chat/search popups when they open
e33chat.config.message_anim_style.desc: Animation style for new message bubbles (slide up + fade in, staggered between consecutive messages)
e33chat.config.panel_width.desc: Adjust the chat panel width (400–1600, in physical screen pixels)
e33chat.config.panel_fullscreen.desc: Fill the whole screen width with the chat panel (ignores the panel width setting, off by default)
e33chat.config.blur_enabled.desc: Blur the area behind the chat panel so text stands out
e33chat.config.panel_opacity.desc: Adjust the chat panel background opacity (0–100)
e33chat.config.debug_log.desc: Write message-handling details to latest.log (for troubleshooting)
e33chat.config.own_mention_notify.desc: Also show a sound and banner when you @ yourself (testing aid, off by default)
e33chat.config.own_quote_notify.desc: Also show a sound and banner when you quote yourself (testing aid, off by default)
e33chat.config.own_whisper_notify.desc: Also show a sound and banner when you whisper yourself via /msg (testing aid, off by default)
e33chat.config.own_bubble_color.desc: Set the background color of your own bubbles
e33chat.config.other_bubble_color.desc: Set the background color of other players' bubbles
e33chat.config.own_text_color.desc: Set the text color inside your own bubbles
e33chat.config.other_text_color.desc: Set the text color inside other players' bubbles
e33chat.config.bubble_corner_radius.desc: Adjust the bubble corner radius (0–10, 0 = square)
e33chat.config.message_gap.desc: Vertical gap between chat messages (0–12 pixels)
e33chat.config.bubble_size.desc: Height of the bubble text in pixels (5–14, default 9). The bubble frame and quote block scale proportionally; the name row and avatar keep their size
e33chat.config.avatar_size.desc: Size of the avatar in chat bubbles (12–32 pixels)
e33chat.config.system_chat_as_bubble.des: Show system messages as chat bubbles instead of small gray text
e33chat.config.anti_spam.desc: Merge consecutive identical messages into one with a counter
e33chat.config.chat_history.desc: Save chat history per world and restore it on rejoin
e33chat.config.preserve_input.desc: Keep the text in the input box when closing the chat screen
e33chat.config.close_chat_on_send.desc: Close the chat screen right after sending a message (vanilla behaviour). Off by default so you can send several messages in a row
e33chat.config.color_codes.desc: Color your own bubbles using & codes (safe, never kicks you)
e33chat.config.time_separator.desc: Insert a time label between messages after a gap (0 = off)
e33chat.config.blocked_players.desc: Blocked players' messages vanish entirely: vanilla chat, bubbles, banners and sounds (edit exact names line by line)
e33chat.config.sound_system.desc: Play a sound for system messages (join / leave / etc.)
e33chat.config.sound_whisper.desc: Play a sound for whisper messages
e33chat.config.sound_public.desc: Play a sound for public chat messages
e33chat.config.sound_volume.desc: Adjust the master volume of all notification sounds (0–100)
e33chat.config.sidebar_hide_patterns.des: Hide players matching these wildcards from the sidebar list (comma-separated, * = wildcard)
e33chat.config.system_banner_enabled.des: Pop a banner for system messages (deaths/joins/broadcasts). On by default.
e33chat.config.mention_banner_enabled.de: Pop a notification banner at the top when @mentioned
e33chat.config.mention_banner_duration.d: Set how long the notification banner stays (2–10 seconds)
e33chat.config.mention_sound_enabled.des: Play a chime when @mentioned or quoted
e33chat.config.mention_whisper_banner.de: Also pop a banner for incoming whisper messages
e33chat.config.mention_require_at.desc: Only trigger a mention when the name has a leading @ (off = bare names count too)
e33chat.config.banner_corner_radius.desc: Adjust the notification banner corner radius (0–10, 0 = square)
e33chat.config.banner_offset_x.desc: Adjust the banner's horizontal position (pixels, negative = left, centered by default)
e33chat.config.banner_offset_y.desc: Adjust the banner's vertical position (pixels, negative = up, centered by default)
e33chat.config.history_retention.desc: Delete history files older than this many days when joining a world (0 = keep forever)

e33chat.server.console_only: GUI can only be opened by a player
e33chat.server.gen_failed: Could not identify a player name in that message; check it or type the template manually

e33chat.tutorial.quick.title: Quick start
e33chat.tutorial.quick:
1. Open the Chat Templates tab → click [Generate from message…]
2. Paste/type a real line with a name (e.g. [VIP]Steve: hello) → click [Generate]
3. The template is added automatically; the preview box fills in that line and shows the parse result (name=xxx | content=xxx)
4. Adjust the template or preview if the result is wrong; click [Save] at the bottom when done

Whisper templates: same flow in the Whisper Templates tab, using a whisper line (e.g. Alex whispered to you: in there?)
Right-click Copy saves only the body text — just type a sample line with a name instead
e33chat.tutorial.concept.title: What is a template
e33chat.tutorial.concept:
Plugins/NCR often reformat chat; the guards can only tell "a player is speaking" but cannot read the name and body out of an unfamiliar format.
A template tells the mod where the name and body sit — one template parses most formats.
Display name = the full name with titles: in [Survival][Newbie]player>>hello the display name is [Survival][Newbie]player and the body is hello — the template {display_name}{sep}{content} parses it
e33chat.tutorial.fields.title: How to fill
e33chat.tutorial.fields:
Fields: {display_name} display name (with titles) | {external} external/QQ sender (need not be an online player) | {content} body | {prefix} leading decoration | {sender}/{target} whisper sender/receiver | {sep} auto-matches >>, :, ：, » or spaces
Example: {display_name}{sep}{content} matches Steve: hello, Steve >> hello and Steve hello
QQ group relays: {external} does not require the name to be an online player — [{prefix}] <{external}> {content} matches [Group] <Nick> hello
Whisper: {sender} whispered to you{sep}{content} matches Alex whispered to you: in there?
{content} can sit anywhere (suffix styles work too); multi-colored names are handled automatically
Fill in the shape you see in chat, then verify with the preview box
e33chat.tutorial.faq.title: FAQ
e33chat.tutorial.faq:
Template never matches? Separators must match verbatim (what you type is what it matches); a title containing a colon truncates the name
Generate failed? The message must contain an online or seen player name
"Seen" = the mod remembers players you chatted with, so it recognizes them even offline
A nickname that shares no characters with the real name, while offline, may not resolve (shows grey) — known limitation
Empty template list? The guards take over, everything works as before
QQ group messages not parsing? EasyBot compat is on by default and handles the <Nick> content shape; if you customized the template, override it with {external}
Permissions/file? /e33chat gui needs OP; config lives in <world>/serverconfig/e33chat-server.toml (Fabric: .json)
e33chat.tutorial.why.title: How it works (brief)
e33chat.tutorial.why:
e33chat judges messages with three guards: translation keys/click events first (Guard 0), then name position + separator structure (Guard 1), finally "not sure → don't claim, show grey" (Guard 2).
A template = you declare the format: a hit splits the fields directly and skips the guard chain.
Recognition ≠ parsing: guards guess "is this a player", templates read the exact name and body.
(Does not affect usage — feel free to skip)
e33chat.server.tpl_set_unknown_fields: Warning: unknown placeholder %s will be treated literally
e33chat.server.tpl_test_no_match: No match — the message falls back to heuristic guards
e33chat.server.use_tpa.desc: When enabled, the head-menu teleport action uses /tpa instead of /tp. /tpa is provided by server plugins (EssentialsX etc.) or mods (FTB Essentials) — vanilla servers have no /tpa.
e33chat.server.history.desc: On join, the server sends recent chat history to new players. Only affects servers that run the e33chat server-side component.
e33chat.server.media_enabled.desc: Host chat images on the server (e33chat://media/, permanent); off = images go through the third-party host only.
e33chat.server.media_auto_clean.desc: Automatically delete server-hosted chat images older than 7 days (checked on server start, then at most every 6h after uploads). Off = images kept forever.
e33chat.server.easybot_compat.desc: On by default: QQ group messages relayed by EasyBot are parsed as player bubbles (the group label is optional — [Group] <Nick(QQ#)> content, <Nick> content and <Nick（group card）> content all parse), and EasyBot/ChatImage CICode images render inside bubbles. Off = they stay in the system-message channel.
e33chat.server.template_debug.desc: Logs every system-chat line that fails every template to the client log (prefix: System(template miss)). Useful while tuning templates.
e33chat.server.template_n.desc: Template format: {prefix} decoration prefix, {display_name} player name (may include decorations), {external} external/QQ sender (does not need to be a known player), {content} message body (must be the last field), {sender}/{target} whisper sender/receiver. Leave the list empty to disable templates and let the guards take over.
e33chat.server.actions.desc: Add creates a blank template row. Below, the preset section offers common formats ready to add in one click.
e33chat.server.gen.desc: Paste a real chat line and generate — the template is inferred automatically (the message must contain an online or seen player name).
e33chat.server.preview.desc: Type any message to preview parsing instantly — shows the matched name and content.
e33chat.config.receive_images.desc: When off, image codes in chat history render as plain [Image] text and nothing is downloaded
e33chat.config.upload_url.desc: Blank = default host (uguu.se, ~3h expiry). Custom hosts need multipart POST: file field defaults to files[], extra fields to none, response defaults to json:files[0].url (override uploadField/uploadExtra/uploadResponse in the config file)
e33chat.upload.queue_full: Upload queue full, please try again later
e33chat.config.hide_repeated_avatars.des: Only the first message of a same-sender run (within 5 min) shows avatar and name; the rest render as bubbles with tighter spacing (Discord/Telegram-style). Off = every message fully shown
